thesis: The Acting Chairman of the CFTC explains that the agency is the primary U.S. derivatives regulator with a history rooted in agriculture before becoming an independent agency in 1975. He emphasizes that the Commission operates with a collegial atmosphere to achieve consensus on policy that ensures fair and transparent markets while working closely with fellow regulators like the SEC and prudential regulators.
